title: Singkamas (Jicama) Salad
description: Singkamas, a Filipino salad, combines jicama, onion, carrots, bell peppers, ginger, and chile peppers with a simple vinegar, sugar, and salt dressing
ingredients: 1 large jicama, peeled and cut into matchsticks
1 red bell pepper, cut into long thin strips
1 green bell pepper, cut into long thin strips
1 small red onion, sliced into thin lengthwise slivers
2 green chile peppers - halved lengthwise, seeded, and cut into strips
1 (2 inch) piece fresh ginger root, thinly sliced

steps.text: Combine jicama, bell peppers, onion, green chile peppers, carrot, and ginger in a large bowl.
Whisk water, vinegar, sugar, and salt together in a separate bowl; pour over vegetable mixture and toss to coat. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.
